source_text: 从前有个人养了一群羊。一天早上他准备出去放羊，发现少了一只。他仔细一看，看到 羊栏(she叩iold)上有个窟窿。显然，夜间有狼钻进羊圈叼走了羊。 邻居劝他修羊栏，可是他不听。 真二天，他发现狼又通过窟窿叼走一只羊。他想起邻居的话，就赶快堵上窟窿，把羊栏补 好。此后，他的羊再也没有被狼叼走。 故事告诉我们:出了问题及时补救，可以防止蒙受更大损失。
reference_translation: Once upon a time, there was a man who raised a flock of sheep. One morning, when he was about to take the sheep out to graze, he found that one sheep was missing. He took a closer look and saw a hole in the sheepfold. Obviously, a wolf had got into the sheepfold through the hole and carried off a sheep during the night. His neighbor advised him to repair the sheepfold, but he didn't listen. The next day, he found that the wolf had carried off another sheep through the hole. He remembered what his neighbor had said and quickly blocked the hole and fixed the sheepfold. After that, no more of his sheep were carried off by wolves. This story tells us that timely remedies for problems can prevent greater losses.
